description: One in-app product or subscription as its store has it: kind, state, name and description per language, the US price, a subscription's period and free trial, on the App Store its subscription group, review note, Family Sharing and image (the one the App Store shows with it: url, Apple's state; Google Play keeps none), and under review what the store still needs before it can go to people and the next step (submit or activate). platform is ios or android; a Google Play subscription's productId is "product:basePlan", as the purchases list shows it. With no productId, what a new one needs: the store's primary language, the languages it takes, and the App Store's subscription groups.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_product_get
title: Read an in-app product
